old_problem: DeepSeek reduced a hybrid speed/connectivity/WOL/power/LED case to manual-only; supported modes and vendor LED meanings were unbound.
disposition_reason: The state sequence is clear and missing port/speed/LED expectations are project runtime parameters. Physical LED observation remains operator-owned under ED-09, while OS link/IP/ping evidence is automatable; unsupported speeds are skipped only with specification proof under ED-13.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row52 all18 XLSX cells and history2664.
Preserved every supported speed plus powered-off, powered-on idle and powered-on traffic states with WOL disabled.
Required real timestamped LED photos and rejected ethtool as a visual substitute; no link, WOL or power state changed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized hybrid NIC speed/connectivity/WOL/power and physical LED validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved supported NIC speed negotiates and communicates and its physical speed/activity LED matches vendor specification across off, idle and traffic states with defined WOL behavior.
required_package: NIC physical-port/MAC/BDF/netdev and isolated link-partner mapping
Authoritative supported-speed/duplex/autoneg matrix and vendor LED color/blink/off table
Approved IP/peer/ping plan and non-management exclusions
Operator/KVM for LED photos and WOL-disabled power-off/on states
Independent OOB recovery, per-speed timeout/abort and complete speed/IP/WOL rollback
test_case.test_command: For each spec-supported speed, validate the isolated target/peer, capture baseline, apply only the approved speed/duplex/autoneg and test IP, confirm negotiated state and bounded ping. Operator disables WOL as approved and captures timestamped physical-port photos/video during powered-off, powered-on idle and powered-on traffic states. Correlate OS traffic timestamps with LED evidence, then restore speed/IP/WOL exactly.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable speed negotiates and passes connectivity; off/idle/traffic LED color/state/blink matches the vendor matrix; WOL behavior and final configuration match approved expectations without errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires supported-speed proof, negotiated/link/traffic evidence and genuine physical LED evidence for every required state. OS telemetry cannot replace photos, and unsupported modes require SPEC-backed N/A.
safety_gate: Never force an unsupported mode or modify the sole management interface.
Operator owns power and physical observation; no autonomous power cycle.
Capture speed/IP/WOL baseline and independent OOB before changes.
Abort on link recovery timeout, management impact, wrong port/LED identity or platform error; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Per-speed configuration, negotiated state and ping output
WOL setting plus operator power-state record
test_case.recovery: On wrong negotiation, lost reachability or ambiguous LED identity, stop the current state, use independent OOB to restore the recorded speed/IP/WOL settings, preserve OS and photo timestamps, and require network/operator review before any further speed or power state.
